title: European Union Update — May 31, 2026
summary: EU ambassadors (Coreper) formally endorsed the EU-US trade deal on May 27, with the EP INTA committee vote set for June 2 and full plenary ratification June 15-18 ahead of Trump's July 4 deadline.
